items.title: Set the server size to 7 players
items.why: Each player gets one of the 7 workshop plots in the spawn area (docs/WORKSHOP_SPEC.md). With a larger server, an 8th player would get no plot. Rojo can't set the server size, so it's set by hand in the place settings.
items.blocks: Publishing a server with workshops (Studio tests are unaffected)
steps: In Studio, open Home > Game Settings > Places.
Open the place's settings (the ... button > Edit) and set Server Size (Max Players) to 7.
Save, then tell Claude "server size 7".

items.title: Click Connect in Studio's Rojo plugin
items.why: Rojo is running again (rojo serve) but Studio has to connect to it so the place runs exactly the repo code for /compat-check. It will replace Studio's RollToast with the repo version (the Studio versions are saved on branch studio/racer-hud-ui).
steps: In Studio, open the Plugins tab > Rojo.
Click Connect (localhost:34872). Accept the sync if it asks.
Tell Claude "rojo connected".
items.verified: Studio scripts match the repo (RollToast 33807 bytes with the fly-icon fix).

items.title: Reopen Studio WITHOUT saving to recover two deleted HUD items
items.why: Claude deleted Client/Ui (Racer HUD) in Edit mode after exporting only part of it: Ui/RollShowcase and Ui/RacerMotion were not exported, and Studio's undo did not restore them. They still exist in the last saved version of the place.
items.blocks: Saving the complete Racer HUD to git (branch studio/racer-hud-ui) and finishing the compat check
steps: Do NOT press Ctrl+S or publish.
Close Roblox Studio and choose Don't Save.
Reopen the place "Racer RNG" (Edit mode, do not press Play).
Tell Claude "reopened"; Claude exports every item under StarterPlayerScripts.Client/Ui and RacerUiController from Edit mode before changing anything.
items.verified: Reopened without saving. The place never held the HUD scripts; Ui/RollShowcase and Ui/RacerMotion are not recoverable on this machine (noted in drafts/ui/racer-hud/DRAFT.md on branch studio/racer-hud-ui).

items.title: Save the Racer HUD ScreenGuis to files
items.why: The HUD's baked ScreenGuis (RacerHud, RacerIndex, RacerStats, RacerSettings, RollShowcase) exist only in the place. Claude moved them to ServerStorage.RacerHudStash for the compat check; they are not in git.
items.blocks: Rebuilding the Racer HUD from the repo later
items.when: Any time after the compat check.
steps: In Explorer open ServerStorage > RacerHudStash.
Select the five ScreenGuis, right-click > Save to File, and save them as `~/Documents/RobloxGames/drafts/ui/racer-hud/RacerHudGuis.rbxm`.
Tell Claude; it adds the file to branch studio/racer-hud-ui.
To use the HUD in the place again, drag the five ScreenGuis back into StarterGui.

items.title: Save the place after the stray spawn was deleted
items.why: Claude deleted the stray Workspace.SpawnLocation (-2, 0.5, -2) in Edit mode. Studio only keeps that change if you save; otherwise it comes back next time and the spawn_area test fails again.
items.blocks: Keeping spawn_area green (exactly one spawn in the game)
items.when: After the compat check finishes (play stopped), not during a test run.
steps: Make sure play is stopped (Edit mode).
Check Explorer: Workspace has no `SpawnLocation` directly under it (Workspace.SpawnArea is built only during play).
Press Ctrl+S (File > Save to Roblox) to save the place.
Mark this done.
items.verified: Claude, 2026-10-05: after a Studio restart the place has exactly one SpawnLocation (SpawnArea.Spawn) during play.

items.title: Remove the extra Baseplate saved in the place
items.why: world-tester found two identical Workspace.Baseplate parts (2048x16x2048 at 0,-8,0), both purple-ish (180,107,191) instead of the green Rojo defines in default.project.json. One is most likely an old Baseplate saved in the place file next to the Rojo one. Harmless for physics, but it z-fights and hides the intended green ground.
items.blocks: Nothing (cosmetic, keeps the place matching the repo)
items.when: With the place save after the compat check (Studio in Edit mode).
steps: In Edit mode, select Workspace and look for two children named `Baseplate`.
Decide which ground colour you want: green (the repo's default.project.json) or purple. If purple is intended, tell Claude so it updates default.project.json instead.
Delete the one that is NOT managed by Rojo (Rojo recreates its own on sync; if unsure, delete one, wait a few seconds and check one Baseplate remains).
Save the place (Ctrl+S).

items.title: Reopen Studio so the compat check can finish
items.why: The compat check stopped halfway: the harness ran (23/24 pass) but the UI, multiplayer and world testers were cut off by a usage limit, and Studio is no longer connected to Claude.
items.blocks: An ALL GREEN /compat-check, which is what lets initial-import go to main
steps: Open Roblox Studio with the place "Racer RNG" (Edit mode, not playing).
Make sure the Roblox Studio MCP is enabled (Assistant settings) and the Rojo plugin is connected (`rojo serve` is already running in the project).

Optional but recommended: in the Explorer, delete `Workspace.SpawnLocation` (the default spawn at -2, 0.5, -2; NOT `Workspace.SpawnArea.Spawn`) and save the place (Ctrl+S). It is the only harness failure: the game must have exactly one spawn. If you skip this, Claude deletes it in Edit mode and asks you to save.
Tell Claude "Studio is open".

items.title: Import the Rusty Hatchback into Studio
items.why: Studio can only import a 3D file through its own Import 3D window; no script or MCP tool can do it. Until this is done the Rusty Hatchback shows a "?" in rolls.
items.blocks: Rusty Hatchback in the game (TODO: Import the Rusty Hatchback into Studio)
items.when: Not while a test run is using Studio (wait for the compat check to finish; the Agents tab shows physics-tester / ui-tester as running).
steps: In Roblox Studio (place "Racer RNG"), open File > Import 3D (or Avatar tab > Import 3D).
Pick `~/Documents/RobloxGames/blender/exports/rusty_hatchback/RustyHatchback.fbx`.
In the importer check the size reads about 6.6 studs long. If it is 100x too big or small, change the file units (Stud / Meter) until it does.
Keep it importing as ONE model, then click Import. Leave it wherever Studio puts it.
Tell Claude "hatchback imported". Claude renames and orients it, makes it non-colliding and massless, checks the mesh and texture ids uploaded, and moves it to ReplicatedStorage.CarModels.

items.title: Save the hatchback model to the repo
items.why: The place file is not in git, so other developers only get the model if it is saved as a file Rojo can sync.
items.when: After Claude has finished setting up the imported model (it will say so).
steps: In Studio's Explorer, open ReplicatedStorage > CarModels and right-click RustyHatchback.
Choose Save to File... and save it as `~/Documents/RobloxGames/assets/CarModels/RustyHatchback.rbxm` (create the CarModels folder if asked).
Tell Claude "rbxm saved". Claude maps ReplicatedStorage.CarModels to assets/CarModels in default.project.json and sets Model = "RustyHatchback" in Cars/rusty_hatchback.luau.

items.title: Confirm two upgrade tree decisions
items.why: Claude made two calls the spec did not spell out. Both are easy to change now and harder after the UI is built.
steps: Read docs/UPGRADE_TREE_DESIGN.md, sections "Tile ids and the tree" and "Prices".
Decision 1: Turbo forks off Roll Speed I (so its first tier is never the first purchase) instead of having its own direction from Start.
Decision 2: prices round halves UP (Roll Speed I $230, Walkspeed II $170).
Tell Claude "keep both", or what to change. Changing a price means test-writer updates the test first.

items.title: Let Studio use DataStores (to test real saving)
items.why: Real DataStore saving has never been tested: Studio blocks it by default, so only a stubbed store is tested (the console shows StudioAccessToApisNotAllowed).
items.when: Any time Studio is not running a test.
steps: In Studio: Home > Game Settings > Security.
Turn on "Enable Studio Access to API Services" and Save.
Tell Claude "API access on"; Claude then tests saving and loading for real.

items.title: Revoke the exposed Slack token and reinstall the bot
items.why: A user (xoxp) Slack token was exposed earlier (ProjectContext TODO 3). Only you can revoke it and install the app.
steps: At api.slack.com/apps, open the app, go to OAuth & Permissions and revoke the old xoxp token.
Add bot scopes: chat:write, channels:read, channels:history, groups:read, groups:history, users:read, reactions:write. Reinstall to the workspace and copy the new xoxb- token.
In a terminal: `claude mcp remove slack --scope user`, then re-add the Slack MCP with the xoxb- token and SLACK_TEAM_ID=T0C5AK11CNB.
In Slack: `/invite` the bot to #racer-dev.

items.title: Reconnect the Blender MCP add-on (optional)
items.why: The Blender add-on is out of date and not connected, so Claude cannot see or edit an open Blender scene. Exports still work headless, so this only matters for new modelling work.
items.when: Before the next car or prop draft.
steps: In a terminal: `uvx mcp-for-blender install-addon`.
Restart Blender (or Preferences > Add-ons: disable and re-enable "Interface: Blender MCP").
In the 3D view press N, open the BlenderMCP tab and click Start MCP Server / Connect.
